description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (25s)], grants [ATK, MAG and MND 30%, DEF and RES 25% (25s)] and [Quick Cast] to all allies, grants [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Gordon] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Gordon
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for Support abilities, casts Spirit Attack: Gordon after using a Support ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Mark of Resolve+
description.text: Transfers the user's Soul Break points to the target, grants [Instant Cast 1]

description.name: Flames of Kashuan+
description.text: 4 single hybrid attacks (1.10 or 3.60 each), causes [DEF -50% (8s)] or [RES -50% (8s)] depending on higher stat of ATK/MAG

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (25s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (25s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (25s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (25s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (25s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (25s)], [Imperil Water 20% (25s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (25s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (25s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (25s)]

description.name: ATK, MAG and MND 30%, DEF and RES 25% (25s)
description.text: ATK, MAG and MND 30%, DEF and RES 25%

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
